NeoSkriptProxyEffSend.name: Send Network Message
description: Sends a message on a channel to every other server, or to the servers named: over Redis where it's on, else through the proxy. With nobody online to carry it through the proxy, it waits for the next player.
examples: send network message "restart in 5 minutes" on channel "alerts" to all servers

NeoSkriptProxyEvtNetwork.name: On Network Message
description: A message from another server arrived, on any channel or those named. Runs on the server's main thread (the global thread on Folia).

NeoSkriptProxyExprNetworkMessage.name: Network Message
description: The message in an on network message trigger.

NeoSkriptProxyExprNetworkChannel.name: Network Channel
description: The channel of the message in an on network message trigger.

NeoSkriptProxyExprNetworkSender.name: Network Sender
description: The name of the server a network message came from, if it's known.

NeoSkriptProxyExprServers.name: Network Servers
description: The servers behind the proxy. Waits for the proxy's answer.

NeoSkriptProxyExprPlayerCount.name: Network Player Count
description: How many players are on the network, or on one server. Waits for the proxy's answer; nothing if it doesn't know the server.
examples: set {_count} to the network player count of server "lobby"

NeoSkriptProxyExprPlayers.name: Network Players
description: The names of the players on the network, or on one server. Waits for the proxy's answer.
examples: set {_names::*} to the network players on server "lobby"

NeoSkriptProxyExprPlayerServer.name: Network Server of Player
description: The server a player is on, or nothing if they're not online. Waits for the proxy's answer.
examples: set {_server} to the network server of arg-1

NeoSkriptProxyExprServerName.name: This Server's Network Name
description: This server's name on the proxy. Waits for the proxy's answer.
examples: set {_me} to this server's network name

NeoSkriptProxyExprSkProxyPlayerCount.name: Player Count of Server
description: SkProxy's and Skelocity's: how many players are on a server, 0 if the proxy doesn't know it. Waits for the proxy's answer, where they answer from what they heard last.

NeoSkriptProxyExprSkProxyStatus.name: Server Status
description: SkProxy's: Online if the proxy knows the server, else Offline.

NeoSkriptProxyExprSkProxyTotal.name: Proxy Player Count
description: SkProxy's and Skelocity's: how many players are on the network.

NeoSkriptProxyExprSkelocityPlayers.name: Proxy Players
description: Skelocity's: the names of the players on the network, or on one server.
examples: set {_names::*} to all proxy players on server "lobby"

NeoSkriptProxyExprSkelocityServer.name: Server of Player
description: Skelocity's: the server a player here is on, as the proxy names it.

NeoSkriptProxyEffBroadcast.name: Network Broadcast
description: Skelocity's: a message to every player on the network, through the proxy. MiniMessage and legacy colour codes work.

NeoSkriptProxyEffKick.name: Proxy Kick
description: Skelocity's: kicks a player from the whole network, through the proxy.

NeoSkriptProxyEffSendRedis.name: Send Redis Message
description: SkRedis's: publishes a message on a Redis channel, in SkRedis's format, so servers with SkRedis hear it.

NeoSkriptProxyEffSendCustomRedis.name: Send Custom Redis Message
description: SkRedis's: publishes a JSON object on a Redis channel, as it is.
examples: send custom redis message "{""kind"":""ping""}" to channel "chat"

NeoSkriptProxyEvtRedis.name: On Redis Message
description: SkRedis's: a message sent with send redis message arrived, on any channel. Runs on the server's main thread (the global thread on Folia).

NeoSkriptProxyEvtCustomRedis.name: On Custom Redis Message
description: SkRedis's: a JSON object with no SkRedis action arrived.

NeoSkriptProxyExprRedisMessage.name: Redis Message
description: SkRedis's: the message in on redis message or on custom redis message.

NeoSkriptProxyExprRedisChannel.name: Redis Channel
description: SkRedis's: the channel of the Redis message.

NeoSkriptProxyExprRedisDate.name: Redis Message Date
description: SkRedis's: when the message was sent, as text.
examples: send redis message date to console

NeoSkriptProxyCondNetworkVariables.name: Network Variables Are Available
description: Whether {network::...} variables are shared and their database answers now. While it's down, scripts still read and change their copy, and the changes are written, and merged with other servers', once it's back; check this before something that shouldn't happen twice, like a reward.
